label: Antonio de Beatis

claims.statement: Secretary of Cardinal Luigi d'Aragona. His diary records a visit to Leonardo.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Travel diary.

value.text: Visit to Leonardo at Cloux, 10 October 1517

claims.statement: His travel diary records that the cardinal and his suite visited Leonardo at Cloux on 10 October 1517 and saw three pictures (a Florentine lady done for Giuliano de' Medici, a young St John the Baptist, and the Virgin and Child with St Anne); it calls Leonardo an old man of over seventy and notes paralysis of his right hand.

sources.cite: Jheronimus Bosch Art Center, review of the Beatis diary (cites Hale 1979, p. 132). Seen in a web search result summary only; the page was not opened in this session.
Heidelberg digital library, Pastor 1905 edition of the diary. Seen in a web search result summary only; the page was not opened in this session.

open_questions: Birth and death dates not found. His statement that Leonardo was 'over seventy' contradicts the 1452 birth: record as testimony, not as age.
